{{SandboxOnly}} {{ModifierInfobox |title1 = April fools 2022 |image1 = AprilFools2022ModifierIcon.png |affects = Enemy Appearance
Tower Appearance
Sounds |active_in = [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] exclusive |sandbox = Yes |rewards_increase = +50% }} {{QuoteContainer| {{QuoteBox|Randomizes everything.|In-Game Description}} }} __TOC__ ==Description== '''April fools 2022''', internally referred to as '''AprilFools2023''', is a [[Modifiers|modifier]] which is meant to randomize multiple parts of the game. ==Effects== When activated, '''April fools 2022''' randomizes the game in the same way it was in [[April Fools 2022]]. All tower and enemy faces will be replaced with the man and woman faces, though some other images like the [[Vindicator (Legacy)|Vindicator]]'s hammer will also be affected. Most tower, enemy and unit animations and sounds will also be randomized. ==Trivia== *The image icon of this modifier is of the third version of the Level 0 [[Demoman]], plastered with a McDonald's burger in where its grenade would be. ==Update History== *'''16 December 2024''' - [[v1.46.0]] **'''April fools 2022''' added, exclusively appearing in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode. **{{Bug}} None of the effects work. *'''15 January 2025''' - [[v1.49.0]] **{{Bugfix}} Effects now work. {{ModifierNavBox}} {{DISPLAYTITLE:April fools 2022}}
